deployments_detail.use: AI in compound design ("7-day" molecule development); Wuhan AI-driven robotic lab (3 chemical-reaction validations/sec); open API/joint labs enabling 300+ startups
Cross-listed (also in CSI300) — AI compound design, robotic lab (CLAIMED tier)

AI-powered retrosynthesis route planning: WuXi AppTec uses Chemical.AI's ChemAIRS to generate diverse synthetic routes, identify difficult synthesis steps, and verify availability of starting materials/intermediates in medicinal chemistry and process development. A WuXi AppTec VP of Medicinal Chemistry endorses its active use; in a 2021 evaluation WuXi concluded ChemAIRS was the top-performing retrosynthesis platform. [Chemical.AI (ChemAIRS)]

DEL+ML machine-learning-enhanced DNA-encoded library (DEL) hit finding: WuXi AppTec HitS trains ML models on billions of DEL screening data points to predict active hits and compound potency, then applies physics-based filtering for drug-like properties. Offered in production to customers via the DELight self-service platform through a partnership with Schrödinger. [Schrödinger]

WuXi AppTec scientists combined experimental DEL screening data with Cyclica's MatchMaker deep-learning model for protein-ligand interaction prediction, demonstrating that integrating DEL data with the deep-learning model yields more accurate hit predictions than either method alone. [Cyclica (MatchMaker deep-learning model)]

Experimental validation of AI-generated molecules: WuXi AppTec's laboratories synthesize and test novel compounds generated by Insilico Medicine's generative adversarial network / reinforcement learning pipelines (GENTRL), providing rapid experimental validation of AI-designed molecules against challenging drug targets, including orphan targets with no known crystal structure. [Insilico Medicine (GANs / GENTRL)]

Computer-Aided Drug Design (CADD) platform provides integrated drug discovery services from hit ID to IND stage using CADD techniques and in-house AI/ML tools, including AI/ML-driven virtual screening of small-molecule libraries. [WuXi AppTec (in-house AI/ML tools)]

Faxian Therapeutics, a joint venture launched by WuXi AppTec and Schrödinger, applies Schrödinger's physics-based/computational precision molecular design platforms accelerated through WuXi AppTec's discovery, synthesis and testing capabilities to accelerate drug discovery. [Schrödinger (Faxian Therapeutics JV)]

WuXi GalaXi virtual compound library (billions of enumerated drug-like compounds) is used within WuXi AppTec's CADD/virtual screening workflows as a computational screening resource for structure-based virtual screening and hit finding, accessible to customers via LabNetwork. [WuXi AppTec (GalaXi)]

Pyxis, an in-house AI/intelligent scheduling platform, is deployed in WuXi AppTec's toxicology/safety-assessment labs to instantly generate and regenerate study schedules, push task notifications to technician handheld devices, and auto-capture timestamped documentation, optimizing room/personnel utilization across pharmacy, pathology, QA and toxicology teams. [WuXi AppTec (in-house, Pyxis)]
